results.title: European Commission accepts Temu action plan over DSA breach
results.snippet:
Temu submitted the plan in August following the EC's May 2026 non-compliance decision, which found the company had not met its obligations and imposed a €200m ($233m) fine.

The EC had previously issued preliminary findings in July 2025, raising concerns about a potential DSA breach.

The plan includes five corrective measures.
